prompt: Create an original 180 second Middle Eastern acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: oud, qanun, darbuka. Style: ornamented modal melody with rolling hand-drum rhythm. Tempo approximately 88 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and traditional Middle Eastern instrumental piece featuring a prominent oud melody, supported by rhythmic percussion and a subtle bassline.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而传统的中东器乐作品，以突出的乌德琴旋律为主，辅以富有节奏感的打击乐和低沉的贝斯线。
